title: Bench Endoskeleton composition, contract v1
description: Which components one bench shows for one role, and in which order. References components by Consul service name; never copies their manifests. Structure only; lint.js checks the rules.

role.description: Ribbon tab the bench opens on

plugins.description: Plugins this bench enables (contribution points arrive with milestone M4)

order.description: Tile order on the stage: "<component>/<tile>", "<component>" (all its tiles), "@<service>" (the module of that Consul service, also when it shows no component) or "*" (everything not listed). Unlisted tiles follow in composition order.

gui.description: GUI folder under web/services/, for a service that does not register Meta.gui itself (e.g. C++ services)

tiles.description: Show only these tiles of the component
